title: Japanese-Style Sausage Wrap
description: A fusion of Japanese and Western flavors, this simple yet satisfying wrap is perfect for a quick meal or snack.

ingredients.name: Sausage
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of sausage you like, but Japanese-style sausage is recommended

ingredients.name: Wrap
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of wrap, but rice flour or whole wheat wraps are recommended

ingredients.name: Kabanos
ingredients.notes: Kabanos adds a nice smoky flavor to the wrap

ingredients.name: Delight
ingredients.notes: Delight adds a sweet and crunchy texture to the wrap

ingredients.name: Sesame oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the wraps and adding flavor

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Brush the wraps with sesame oil and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy.
3. Slice the sausage into thin rounds and cook in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the sliced kabanos and delight to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
5. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and grated ginger.
6. Assemble the wraps by spreading a spoonful of the soy sauce mixture on each wrap, followed by a few slices of sausage, kabanos, and delight.
